'''Senior Reporter''' was a position in the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] team of ''[[The Coruscant Holo Net]]'' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], the position was held by [[Nik Kigee]].
